responsibility: Implements dead code elimination on SSA GIMPLE, including both ordinary DCE and aggressive control-dependence-based DCE. It marks obviously necessary statements, propagates liveness backward through SSA defs and, in aggressive mode, through control dependences/postdominators, then removes unnecessary statements and PHIs, updates CFG and dominance information as needed, and also exports a lightweight worklist-driven simple_dce_from_worklist helper used by other optimizers to reap trivially dead defs.
same_name_distinction: This source file implements the full SSA dead-code-elimination passes, including ordinary and aggressive control-dependence-based DCE, CFG updates, and the simple worklist cleanup helper. Unlike gcc/tree-ssa-dce.h, which only declares the lightweight simple_dce_from_worklist interface for other passes, this file contains the full DCE algorithms and pass definitions.
